name: Florida Envirothon
city: Statewide, FL (state contest in Live Oak)
what_you_do: Teams of high school students compete on forestry, wildlife, water life, soils and a current issue. They win a regional contest first, then go to the state contest.
who_can_apply: High school students on a team from a school, homeschool group, 4-H group or nature center group. A full team has 5 competing members. The team registration fee covers up to 2 advisors. Each county sends one team.
deadline_text: Intent to compete due Jan 15 to regional coordinators. Team registration March 1. Payment March 7. State contest April 10, 2027 (tentative) at IFAS Live Oak.
how_to_apply: Join your regional contest first. Regional leaders sign up the winning teams. Then advisors finish signing up and pay.
notes: The key dates page is titled 2026 but lists an April 2027 contest, so confirm the year with organizers. Teams of 4 or fewer can take part but not compete for places.
